params.prompt:
The attached image shows a garment on a wooden hanger, front view. Show the exact same garment from the BACK: the same garment turned around on the same natural wood hanger with the same metal hook, seen straight on from behind. Keep the exact same color, fabric, texture, fit, length, sleeve shape, ribbing and proportions, the same size in the frame and the same framing, so the front and back images line up. Seen from behind, the hanger hook comes out of the back of the collar and the hanger bar is hidden inside the shoulders. Back of a black pullover hoodie: the hood lies flat down the upper back with its seam running down the middle, plain back panel, no kangaroo pocket on the back, ribbed hem and cuffs. No print, no logo.
Ultra-realistic e-commerce product photograph, soft frontal studio light, true-to-life color, real fabric texture. Transparent background around the garment and the hanger, no shadow, no backdrop. Full hanger hook visible at the top center, nothing cropped. No added text, no labels, no props.
